feature_policy.data_availability_gate: For every proposed feature, record when it was actually knowable to an operator, source revision, units, missingness, transformations, and whether it is a forecast or a realized measurement. Do not whitelist a field until that record passes review.

tasks.estimand: Predict whether the retrospective source records a coherent impact/recovery marker triplet; this is a source-recording proxy, not physical truth.
tasks.label_definition: positive iff all three recovery fields are present and individually valid; negative iff all three are sentinel-coded; any mixed triplet is a data-quality failure, not a label.
tasks.sample_policy: All source rows after strict triplet validation; quarantine mixed triplets. Never infer that a missing triplet means zero physical impact.
tasks.benchmark_goal: After feature provenance is audited and sample adequacy is demonstrated, target at least +0.05 absolute PR-AUC over the strongest non-leaking train-only climatology baseline, with storm-cluster uncertainty reported; do not use raw accuracy as the primary score.

tasks.estimand: Predict whether the rounded source field total_impact is greater than zero; this does not mean all zero-valued rows experienced no physical impact.
tasks.label_definition: positive iff the validated integer total_impact is greater than zero. Preserve the four pinned-source cases where total_impact is zero while recovery markers and other impact proxies are present.
tasks.sample_policy: All valid rows; report positive-class counts and positive storm clusters. Do not silently relabel zero-rounded records as confirmed no-impact.
tasks.benchmark_goal: Target positive Brier skill versus the training-prevalence baseline and at least +0.05 absolute PR-AUC versus the strongest non-leaking train-only baseline; show the operational false-alarm/recall trade-off, not a single accuracy headline.

tasks.estimand: Predict the source's non-negative integer rounded equivalent-days-lost value; report zero-inclusive and positive-only performance separately.
tasks.label_definition: Use the validated integer total_impact as the label. Do not use total_impact_value, max_impact, recovery markers, or day_of_recover as predictors for this task.
tasks.sample_policy: Score all rows and separately report rows with total_impact greater than zero; retain zeros to expose excess-zero behavior.
tasks.benchmark_goal: Target at least 10% lower test MAE than the training-only median baseline and improved count deviance, with storm-cluster uncertainty on the difference. Treat this as aspirational until the held-out positive-storm count supports inference.

tasks.estimand: Describe source-recorded day_of_recover among rows with coherent recovery markers; do not claim a forecast target until observation-window and censoring semantics are resolved.
tasks.label_definition: Include only valid rows where the recovery triplet is fully present. Do not impute missing marker triplets to zero and do not label them right-censored without an explicit observation cutoff.
tasks.sample_policy: Descriptive distributions and provenance audit only. Defer predictive evaluation until the original curve construction, at-risk origin, and observation end are recorded.
tasks.benchmark_goal: Before any recovery prediction claim, establish a documented time origin and censoring rule, then demonstrate nominal 90% interval coverage between 85% and 95% on a sufficiently large external set with at least 30 independently observed storm episodes.

paper_reproduction.distinction: The paper reports a random 80:20 development split and a filtered 1,093-row model-fitting subset. The full-corpus chronological SID-grouped test in this contract is intentionally different and its score must not be presented as a like-for-like replication.
required_before_comparison: recover and document the exact filtering rule and retained IDs
match the published split protocol in a clearly isolated reproduction
report the chronological storm-held-out result separately

claim_ceiling: This file freezes task semantics and evaluation policy; it does not fit, validate, or recommend any predictive model.
The pinned public temporal test is reproducible but not a secret blind holdout.
No row-level score may be represented as independent-storm generalization without storm-clustered analysis.
No prediction authorizes a navigation, port closure, emergency, staffing, or other physical/operational decision.
